info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve operational service details related to card transactions using a specific parameter. It is designed to support financial institutions and service providers in accessing critical transaction information efficiently. Typical consumers include developers working on banking applications and integration specialists who require real-time data for transaction processing. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can enhance their operational capabilities and improve service delivery within their banking environments.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific card transaction switch.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about the card transaction switch identified by CARD-400045. It provides the necessary data related to the transaction which can be useful for auditing or operational checks.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving card transaction details associated with a specific operation. This payload should contain all necessary parameters to process the request.

200.description: The request was successful and the response contains the requested data.

GetOperationalServiceByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to card transaction switching services. It is intended to receive data in string format.

GetOperationalServiceByParam1Response_20.description: Represents the response object for a card transaction operation.
